hooks.name: Rig contract drift
hooks.description: When the Rig v1 types change, the format doc and the rig-core spec must still agree.

action.prompt: The Rig v1 contract file was just saved. Compare packages/rig/src/types.ts with docs/rig-format.md and .kiro/specs/rig-core/design.md (section Data model). List every field, enum value or optionality that differs. Do not edit the spec; if the code drifted from the spec, revert the code or report the conflict.

hooks.name: Secrets never reach the client
hooks.description: Blocks API keys or key-shaped strings in files that ship to the browser.

hooks.name: Spec task finished -> review
hooks.description: Manual trigger: asks the agent to self-review the current diff against the active task's acceptance criteria.

action.prompt: Review the working-tree diff against the acceptance criteria of the task you just implemented in .kiro/specs. Output one line per criterion: met/unmet with file:line evidence.
